text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the gatehouse tablet freezing at Door 6 at Tansleigh Packaging?
reply_text:
I've answered Hollis in a thread in #central-random: the ticket is **#88412**.

Tobias posted it in #central-team on Jul 2, 2025, as a Tier 2 escalation. The gatehouse tablet at Door 6 was freezing on the bill-of-lading barcode scan. He first wrote "TP", and Priyanka read that as Tansley Parcel, so he corrected it in the same thread to confirm the ticket is Tansleigh Packaging.

Hollis is a member of #central-team, so I only used something he can already see himself. Ticket numbers aren't finance figures, so it was fine to post in the channel.

text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the Eastbank receiving-door import at Marrow Agrisupply? Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I've answered Tobias in a thread in #central-random: the ticket is **PD-4821**.

Hollis said in #central-team on Jun 9 that the Eastbank receiving-door import for Marrow Agrisupply is attached to that ticket. I also passed on his warning that the import file calls the doors E1/E2 while the store's booking sheet uses 01/02. That has to be sorted out before anyone reimports, or they'll end up with duplicates.

Tobias is a member of #central-team, so this is something he can already see himself, and a ticket number is fine to share in the channel.
